normative_evidence.quote: if the 'DTSTART' property is specified as a date with local time and time zone reference, then the UNTIL rule part MUST be specified as a date with UTC time
UNTIL=19970902T170000Z terminates at 1:00 PM EDT, not 5:00 PM; the correct value is UNTIL=19970902T210000Z

rationale: The RFC's own authors got this wrong in a printed example, and two further errata (5872, 6212) are readers getting it wrong in the opposite direction. One correct and two incorrect errata against UNTIL-in-UTC examples is direct evidence that the local-time/UTC boundary is a comprehension trap.
title: UNTIL must be UTC when DTSTART carries a TZID (erratum 3883's example, corrected)
